domain_areas.name: Authentication & Identity Management
features: User registration with role choices (CUSTOMER, MERCHANT, ADMIN)
JWT Authentication (Login/Logout, Token Refresh, Access token lifespan: 25h)
Profile management and shipping address books
Merchant onboarding & Admin approval workflow

domain_areas.name: Product & Stock Inventory Catalog
features: Category CRUD management
Product CRUD (scoped to merchant store ownership)
Stock inventory tracking and threshold alerts
Synchronous REST-based product and pricing validation during order checkout
Idempotent stock deduction and restoration via RabbitMQ events

domain_areas.name: Order Lifecycle Management
features: Order checkout validation (combining customer role, address and active products)
Idempotency token creation to prevent double checkout submissions
State machine transitions: PENDING -> PAID -> SHIPPING -> DELIVERED (or CANCELLED/REFUNDED)
Transaction outbox logging for Event-Driven updates
User personal order history & Merchant store-specific order inbox

domain_areas.name: Payment Gateway Simulation & Refunds
features: Secure checkout credit card billing mock pipeline
Transaction success/failure status propagation via RabbitMQ events
Outbox-backed refund handling for cancelled orders
Transactional audit logger for payment history charts

domain_areas.name: Automated Drone Routing & Logistics
features: Drone registry, payload capacity, and battery tracking
Automated flight path calculation (coordinate-to-coordinate routing)
Dynamic delivery assignment for PAID orders
Real-time coordinate progression simulation

domain_areas.name: Async Notifications
features: Event-driven email dispatch for order confirmations
Real-time SMS alerts simulation for payment failures
SMTP mail template engine

domain_areas.name: Merchant Dashboard Web UI
features: Merchant-specific KPI metrics (Total sales, today's order count)
Interactive sales charts using Chart.js/Recharts
Product catalog workspace (Add/Edit/Delete products, toggle active status)
Fulfillment control room (receive, accept, assign and dispatch orders)

domain_areas.name: Admin System Dashboard Console
features: System-wide KPIs aggregation (Total revenue, total users, active merchants, order conversion rate)
Global order monitoring feed with live search & filters
Pending merchant application review queue
Global user control panel & permission management
System alerts center (Eureka disconnects, transaction failures)
